title: Something strange
text: The TV shows an obscure word, an odd law or a strange fact, with the real meaning hidden.

title: Write a convincing fake
text: Make up an answer that sounds real enough to fool everyone.

title: Find the truth
text: The real answer is shuffled in with the fakes. Vote for the one you think is true.

title: Scoring
text: Points for finding the truth, and even more for every player your fake fools. The last prompt is the finale!
